config.name: Jellyhook
config.description: See what each lead did on your website before they filled in your form: the pages they read, the time on each, the headings they spent time on, where they came from and the marks and hooks that caught them. Adds a Jellyhook card to contact records with the visit summary and the visit chart. Jellyhook reads which contact has a lead's email and never writes to HubSpot.
